proposals.evidence: The complete Adivasi Oriya compound contains cab- bite, directly compared with Turner’s Oriya cābibā, and the eastern d-l past give auxiliary. Turner 6140 branch 3 records the l-extended past alongside Bengali dila; the local de-vowel is retained. This is a qualified eastern comparative analysis, not a replacement of the source form.
